hypothesis: Removing issue-template boilerplate and URLs from source-hint ranking, then exposing those source-only hints after compact rendering, improves task-3 evidence acquisition so bounded adjacent-test closure can improve final context quality.
mechanism: The ranker strips HTML comments and URLs only for initial hint generation. The compact representation shows the deterministic pinned-base hints as a user message because it otherwise discards the appended system summary. The generic adjacent-test terminal closure from R1 is retained. No benchmark-labeled path, source bytes, gold, or scorer change is embedded.
arm: radical-ranked-acquisition with issue-focused hints and adjacent-test closure
sequence_rule: Run task 3 first. If it fails fixed quality or token screen, stop. Only if task 3 passes, run task 2. No replacement or silent retry.
screen_rule: Task 3 Span-F1 >= 0.5125361243, File-F1 >= 0.8, tokens <= 261037. If it passes, task 2 Span/File-F1 = 1 and tokens <= 461176. Every dispatched call must have known usage and native export valid.
gold_boundary: Generation mounts source-only task and pinned repository data, not gold or reference patches. Native scoring follows sealed generation.
claim_ceiling: Exposed development tasks under configured 1M window; no full-cohort or occupied-deep-window generalization.
